minutes_briefs.title: Burnaby joins inter-municipal business licence program under Bylaw 14852
minutes_briefs.summary: Burnaby has adopted Bylaw 14852, the Inter-Municipal Business Licence Agreement Bylaw 2027. This bylaw lets Burnaby take part in a shared business licence program with other cities, so a business that works in more than one city may be able to use one licence instead of buying a separate one in each city. The bylaw is dated 2027, which suggests the new rules start in that year. The article does not list which cities are in the agreement, what the licence costs, or which types of businesses can use it.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check with Burnaby's licensing department before 2027 to confirm which cities are in the agreement, what it costs, and whether your business type qualifies.
